WIN32.doc: Stable GUI subset implemented by native Windows, SDL3 and mocks.

members.name: Types
members.doc: Shared identities, copied messages and provider exceptions.

members.name: Kernel
members.doc: Module, native error and monotonic clock support.

members.name: Kernel.getModuleHandle
members.doc: `getModuleHandle name` looks up a process module; NONE selects the application module.

members.name: Kernel.getLastError
members.doc: `getLastError ()` returns the last captured provider error.

members.name: Kernel.setLastError
members.doc: `setLastError code` sets the provider error value.

members.name: Kernel.queryPerformanceCounter
members.doc: `queryPerformanceCounter ()` reads the monotonic performance counter.

members.name: Kernel.queryPerformanceFrequency
members.doc: `queryPerformanceFrequency ()` returns the counter ticks per second.

members.name: User
members.doc: Owning-thread windows, message dispatch, timers and painting.

members.name: User.registerClassEx
members.spec:
val registerClassEx : {name : string, instance : Types.module,
                      style : Word32.word,
                      procedure : Types.window * Types.message -> Types.reply} -> Types.atom
members.doc: `registerClassEx specification` registers a named class and a same-thread window procedure.

members.name: User.unregisterClass
members.doc: `unregisterClass (atom, instance)` unregisters a class after every associated window has ended.

members.name: User.createWindowEx
members.spec:
val createWindowEx : {class : Types.atom, instance : Types.module,
                      title : string, style : Word32.word, extendedStyle : Word32.word,
                      x : int, y : int, width : int, height : int,
                      parent : Types.window option} -> Types.window
members.doc: `createWindowEx specification` creates a window, delivering NcCreate and Create before returning its identity.

members.name: User.destroyWindow
members.doc: `destroyWindow window` destroys the window, delivering Destroy and NcDestroy before closing its identity.

members.name: User.showWindow
members.doc: `showWindow (window, command)` changes visibility and returns the previous visibility.

members.name: User.updateWindow
members.doc: `updateWindow window` processes the pending paint region synchronously.

members.name: User.defWindowProc
members.doc: `defWindowProc (window, message)` performs the provider default action; Close destroys a live window.

members.name: User.getClientRect
members.doc: `getClientRect window` returns its client rectangle.

members.name: User.setWindowText
members.doc: `setWindowText (window, text)` sets the title using WTF-8 at native Windows boundaries.

members.name: User.getMessage
members.spec:
val getMessage : {window : Types.window option, minimum : Word32.word,
                  maximum : Word32.word} -> Types.next
members.doc: `getMessage filter` waits for a matching queued message or a posted quit status.

members.name: User.peekMessage
members.spec:
val peekMessage : {window : Types.window option, minimum : Word32.word,
                   maximum : Word32.word, remove : bool} -> Types.queued option
members.doc: `peekMessage filter` returns a matching copied message when available, optionally removing it.

members.name: User.translateMessage
members.doc: `translateMessage message` requests keyboard text translation and reports whether translation occurred.

members.name: User.dispatchMessage
members.doc: `dispatchMessage message` dispatches a copied message to its window procedure.

members.name: User.postQuitMessage
members.doc: `postQuitMessage status` queues the application quit status.

members.name: User.postMessage
members.doc: `postMessage (window, message)` queues a supported message for later dispatch.

members.name: User.sendMessage
members.doc: `sendMessage (window, message)` dispatches synchronously, permitting nested same-thread sends.

members.name: User.invalidateRect
members.spec: val invalidateRect : Types.window * Types.rect option * bool -> unit
members.doc: `invalidateRect (window, rectangle, erase)` adds a client rectangle to the pending paint region.

members.name: User.beginPaint
members.doc: `beginPaint window` begins a paint scope and returns its invalid rectangle.

members.name: User.endPaint
members.doc: `endPaint (window, paint)` ends the matching paint scope and invalidates its drawing capability.

members.name: User.withPaint
members.doc: `withPaint window body` runs body inside a paint scope and ends it on every returning path.

members.name: User.fillRect
members.spec: val fillRect : Types.paint * Types.rect * Types.brush -> unit
members.doc: `fillRect (paint, rectangle, brush)` fills a rectangle with a live brush.

members.name: User.setTimer
members.spec: val setTimer : Types.window * Word64.word * Word32.word -> Word64.word
members.doc: `setTimer (window, requested, milliseconds)` creates or replaces an owning-thread message timer and returns its identity.

members.name: User.killTimer
members.doc: `killTimer (window, identity)` cancels the associated message timer.

members.name: Gdi
members.doc: Owned and borrowed drawing objects, geometry and text.

members.name: Gdi.createPen
members.spec: val createPen : {style : int, width : int, colour : Word32.word} -> Types.pen
members.doc: `createPen specification` creates an owned drawing pen.

members.name: Gdi.createSolidBrush
members.doc: `createSolidBrush colour` creates an owned solid colour brush.

members.name: Gdi.penObject
members.doc: `penObject pen` returns its generic object identity.

members.name: Gdi.brushObject
members.doc: `brushObject brush` returns its generic object identity.

members.name: Gdi.objectBrush
members.doc: `objectBrush object` returns a brush view after validating the object kind.

members.name: Gdi.selectObject
members.doc: `selectObject (paint, object)` selects a live drawing object and returns the previous selection of that kind.

members.name: Gdi.deleteObject
members.doc: `deleteObject object` deletes an owned, unselected object; borrowed stock objects are rejected.

members.name: Gdi.getStockObject
members.doc: `getStockObject index` returns a borrowed stock drawing object.

members.name: Gdi.moveToEx
members.spec: val moveToEx : Types.paint * int * int -> {x : int, y : int}
members.doc: `moveToEx (paint, x, y)` sets the current drawing point and returns its previous coordinates.

members.name: Gdi.lineTo
members.spec: val lineTo : Types.paint * int * int -> unit
members.doc: `lineTo (paint, x, y)` draws from the current point and updates that point.

members.name: Gdi.rectangle
members.doc: `rectangle (paint, rectangle)` draws an outline and fills the interior using the selected pen and brush.

members.name: Gdi.setTextColor
members.doc: `setTextColor (paint, colour)` sets text colour and returns the previous colour.

members.name: Gdi.setBkMode
members.doc: `setBkMode (paint, mode)` sets transparent or opaque text background mode and returns the previous mode.

members.name: Gdi.textOut
members.spec: val textOut : Types.paint * int * int * string -> unit
members.doc: `textOut (paint, x, y, text)` draws text through the provider with explicit text and rendering limitations.

WIN32_COMMON.doc: Provider support for the shared Win32 type identities.

members.name: Types
members.doc: One public type module reused by native, SDL and mock providers.

members.name: freshWindow
members.doc:
`freshWindow ()` creates an unregistered window token.

A token alone grants no capability; every provider validates its registry.

members.name: freshModule
members.doc: `freshModule ()` creates an unregistered module token.

members.name: freshAtom
members.doc: `freshAtom ()` creates an unregistered class token.

members.name: freshPaint
members.doc: `freshPaint ()` creates an unregistered paint token.

members.name: freshObject
members.doc: `freshObject ()` creates an unregistered object token.

members.name: freshPen
members.doc: `freshPen ()` creates a pen and its associated object identity.

members.name: freshBrush
members.doc: `freshBrush ()` creates a brush and its associated object identity.

members.name: freshQueued
members.doc: `freshQueued ()` creates an unregistered copied-message token.

members.name: penObject
members.doc: `penObject pen` returns the pen's shared object identity.

members.name: brushObject
members.doc: `brushObject brush` returns the brush's shared object identity.

members.name: objectBrush
members.doc:
`objectBrush object` reinterprets the token without granting ownership.

The provider must verify that the associated object is a brush.

members.name: windowKey
members.doc: `windowKey window` returns its process-local diagnostic identity.

members.name: moduleKey
members.doc: `moduleKey module` returns its process-local diagnostic identity.

members.name: atomKey
members.doc: `atomKey atom` returns its process-local diagnostic identity.

members.name: paintKey
members.doc: `paintKey paint` returns its process-local diagnostic identity.

members.name: objectKey
members.doc: `objectKey object` returns its process-local diagnostic identity.

members.name: queuedKey
members.doc: `queuedKey queued` returns its process-local diagnostic identity.

WIN32_GUI_DRIVER.doc: Thin GUI driver used by the shared Win32 SDL and mock semantics.

members.name: window
members.doc: A driver-owned window, separate from the portable public token.

members.name: drawing
members.doc: A drawing scope owned by this driver.

members.name: event
members.spec: datatype event = Quit | Message of window * Win32Common.Types.message
members.doc: A normalized external event; the model owns class procedure dispatch.

members.name: externalEvents
members.doc: Whether events may arrive independently of deterministic model state.

members.name: create
members.doc: `create specification` creates a driver window without invoking SML procedures.

members.name: destroy
members.doc: `destroy window` releases a driver window and its drawing resources.

members.name: show
members.doc: `show (window, command)` applies a supported Win32 visibility command.

members.name: title
members.doc: `title (window, text)` changes the UTF-8 window title.

members.name: client
members.doc: `client window` reads its current client dimensions.

members.name: begin
members.doc: `begin window` acquires a drawing scope.

members.name: finish
members.doc: `finish drawing` presents the completed drawing and releases its scope.

members.name: fill
members.doc: `fill specification` fills an exclusive-edge rectangle with RGB colour.

members.name: line
members.doc: `line specification` draws a solid line with the requested positive width.

members.name: text
members.doc: `text specification` draws fixed ASCII text with the declared background mode.

members.name: poll
members.doc: `poll ()` copies the next available external event.

members.name: ticks
members.doc: `ticks ()` returns monotonic milliseconds as an unbounded integer.

members.name: counter
members.doc: `counter ()` returns the monotonic performance counter.

members.name: frequency
members.doc: `frequency ()` returns performance counter ticks per second.

members.name: delay
members.doc: `delay milliseconds` waits, or advances deterministic mock time.

WIN32_TYPES.doc: Shared public identities and messages for the Win32 GUI subset.

members.name: window
members.doc: An abstract window identity; operations validate its provider and lifetime.

members.name: module
members.doc: An abstract process module identity.

members.name: atom
members.doc: A registered window class owned by one implementation.

members.name: paint
members.doc: An active BeginPaint scope, valid until its matching EndPaint.

members.name: object
members.doc: A GDI object identity; selected and stock objects have distinct ownership.

members.name: pen
members.doc: A pen identity sharing its object lifetime.

members.name: brush
members.doc: A brush identity sharing its object lifetime.

members.name: rect
members.spec: type rect = {left : Int32.int, top : Int32.int, right : Int32.int, bottom : Int32.int}
members.doc: Client coordinates; the right and bottom edges are exclusive.

members.name: message
members.doc:
Normalized GUI messages.

Char carries one UTF-16 code unit, including lone
surrogates. Application preserves the caller's integer payload. Native
default processing retains the original message's complete ABI payload.

members.name: reply
members.spec: datatype reply = Default | Result of Int64.int
members.doc: Default asks the provider to perform its documented default behavior.

members.name: queued
members.doc: A copied message returned by GetMessage or PeekMessage.

members.name: next
members.spec: datatype next = Quit of Int32.int | Message of queued
members.doc: A quit status or one copied queued message.

members.name: Error
members.spec: exception Error of {function : string, code : Word32.word}
members.doc: A captured native-style error, before conversion or resource cleanup.

members.name: Unsupported
members.doc: An explicit operation outside the delivered provider's contract.
